translations.web: They also honored us with many honors, and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.
translations.bsb: The islanders honored us in many ways and supplied our needs when we were ready to sail.
translations.kjv: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.
